title: Training Bulletin — Tenure Credit for Long-Standing Payment Arrangements on Restructure
content:
Which restructured plans earn a tenure credit? Under Payment Arrangements, the plan's age and record decide how many installments, if any, the tenure credit adds to the restructured count.

## The rule

The kept installment payments are the installment payments received under the plan less those returned.

- A plan created at least 6 whole months before the handling date with at least 4 kept installment payments adds 2 installments.
- A plan created at least 3 whole months before with at least 2 kept installment payments, and not in the first case, adds 1.
- Any other plan adds none.

The plan's age is counted in whole calendar months from its creation date to the handling date.

## Questions and answers (hypothetical plans)

**Q. Created 7 whole months ago, 5 kept installment payments?**
At least 6 months and at least 4 kept payments: 2 installments.

**Q. Created 7 whole months ago, 3 kept installment payments?**
Not the first case (fewer than 4 kept); at least 3 months and at least 2 kept: 1 installment.

**Q. Created 4 whole months ago, 4 kept installment payments?**
Under 6 months, so not the first case; at least 3 months and at least 2 kept: 1 installment.

**Q. Created 2 whole months ago, 2 kept installment payments?**
Under 3 months: none.

**Q. Created 9 whole months ago, 1 kept installment payment?**
Fewer than 2 kept: none.

## Grid

| Plan age (whole months) | Kept installment payments | Tenure credit |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | 4 or more | 2 installments |
| 6 or more | 2 or 3 | 1 installment |
| 3 to 5 | 2 or more | 1 installment |
| Any | 0 or 1 | None |
| 0 to 2 | Any | None |
